name: live-md-vscode
description: Edit live-md documents inside VS Code, alongside an agent working on the same document.

liveMd.url.description: Base URL of the live-md server.

liveMd.autoStart.description: Start the live-md server automatically when opening, if nothing is answering at liveMd.url.

liveMd.serverPath.description: Path to the live-md repository. Defaults to whichever open workspace folder is the live-md project.

liveMd.startCommand.description: Command used to start the server, run in the repository directory.
